structured.answer: Nothing decided yet. My shortlist is a קרן כספית for the part of the 30k I want to keep available, and the S&P 500 through a חשבון ניירות ערך at my bank for growth, on top of the קרן השתלמות I already have. The page gave me no fees, numbers or first step, so I'm only half sure.
